coaching.title: Race Day: Julian Alps 50K
coaching.message: Today's the day — 31 miles, ~2,700m up and down on technical alpine terrain out of Kranjska Gora. Start 10-15% slower than goal effort and walk every meaningful climb from mile 1. Keep HR in Zone 2 for the first 6 miles, no exceptions. Miles 1-10: patient. 11-20: settle into rhythm, power hike the steep grades. 21-31: this is where the training shows up — run the descents relaxed and controlled to protect your quads for the finish.

coaching.title: Fuel Right
coaching.message: You already tested breakfast ~3 hours out — oatmeal, banana, peanut butter, toast, coffee if that's your habit, 500ml water with electrolytes. On course: eat every 30 minutes, 250-300 cal/hr, 800-1000mg sodium/hr. Bring in a caffeine gel from mile 20 onward if you need the lift. At every aid station: refill bottles, eat something real, take salt, under 3 minutes and move on.

coaching.title: Recovery
coaching.message: After you cross the line: don't sit down cold — walk 10-15 minutes to let HR come down gradually. Get 20-30g protein plus real carbs in within the first hour, rehydrate with electrolytes (you'll be down more sodium than you think after that vert). Compression socks on, legs up when you can, and prioritize sleep tonight over any celebration logistics — the real adaptation from today happens over the next 72 hours.

coaching.title: Mental Edge
coaching.message: Run the mile you're in. When it gets hard on those climbs, the plan is simple: walk, eat, drink, reassess in 15 minutes. Relentless forward progress. You've done the work — Bled to the finish, one section at a time.
